text:
```yaml
name: Coffee Bot Lottery Poster

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 9 * * *' # Runs at 09:00 UTC, which is 17:00 Beijing time

jobs:
  post-coffee-bot-lottery:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v2
        with:
          java-version: '11'
      
      - name: Add MCP create_post access for bot workflows
        run: |
          echo "MCP_CREATE_POST_ACCESS=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      
      - name: Run coffee bot script
        run: |
          # Assuming the coffee bot script is named post_coffee_bot_lottery.sh
          chmod +x post_coffee_bot_lottery.sh
          ./post_coffee_bot_lottery.sh
```

This GitHub Actions workflow will run the coffee bot script every day at 09:00 Beijing time. The script `post_coffee_bot_lottery.sh` should be added to your repository and contain the logic to post the daily coffee lottery thread. The environment variable `MCP_CREATE_POST_ACCESS` is set to allow the bot to create posts on MCP.
